product.summary: Actively maintained Specter Desktop Bitcoin wallet GUI for hardware-wallet, multisig and Bitcoin Core/Electrum workflows.
product.notes: Support status is `supported` because the official repository contains current August 2026 wallet, dependency and security-related maintenance commits. This does not imply Specter normally holds the user's signing keys.

events.title: Specter Desktop v2.2.0-pre5 released
events.description: The official Specter Desktop repository published the v2.2.0-pre5 prerelease on 2026-08-15 with packaged desktop artifacts, providing dated first-party evidence of continuing application maintenance. This record does not infer the product original launch date.

evidence.title: Specter Desktop current maintenance history
evidence.notes: Official August 2026 commit fixes wallet import behavior; additional August 2026 repository commits include auth/security and compatibility maintenance. Used to establish current supported maintenance state.
